title: ClearFront: extract CSS+data module, establish multi-file skeleton
description: Follow-on to TASK-207 (baseline extraction, APPROVED-pending-review). Per DEC-CF-002/DEC-CF-003 (Projects/ClearFront/shared/decisions.md) and the module map (Projects/ClearFront/artifacts/planning/clearfront-module-map-2026-07-16.md): split Projects/ClearFront/baseline/index.html into a directly-editable multi-file skeleton, starting with the lowest-risk pieces. (1) Move the <style> block (lines 10-1399) to Projects/ClearFront/app/styles/clearfront.css, linked via <link rel=stylesheet>. (2) Move constants + CARD_LIBRARY + PLAYER_DECKLIST/AI_DECKLIST/DECKS/FACTION_POOLS/HERO_NAMES (lines 1655-1799) to Projects/ClearFront/app/js/data.js, attached to a shared window.CF namespace object (NOT bare globals, NOT ES modules -- see DEC-CF-002, must keep working via plain file:// open, no build step, no server). (3) Leave the rest of the current IIFE (engine/render/input, lines ~1800-3797) inline in index.html for now -- those move in follow-on tasks (TASK-209+). (4) Write the new Projects/ClearFront/app/index.html referencing the CSS + data.js via plain <script src> in the correct load order before the existing inline script. Do not touch Projects/ClearFront/baseline/ (that stays the extraction-parity reference) or Projects/ClearFront/source/ (untouched original).
acceptance_criteria: app/styles/clearfront.css contains exactly the CSS from baseline/index.html's <style> block, byte-identical modulo the removed <style></style> tags.

app/js/data.js defines CARD_LIBRARY, PLAYER_DECKLIST, AI_DECKLIST, DECKS, FACTION_POOLS, HERO_NAMES, and the 5 top constants (MAX_BOARD etc.) on a single shared window.CF object; no bare new globals introduced.

app/index.html opens directly via file:// (no server, no build step) and is visually + functionally identical to baseline/index.html: same headless-Chromium screenshot at champion-select, and the same CDP click-through smoke test (deploy a champion, reach turn 1 with a 3-card hand) with zero console errors/exceptions.
baseline/ and source/ are untouched by this task.
Parity evidence recorded in artifacts/tests/task-208-skeleton-parity.md following the TASK-207 report's format.
